name: Pani Puri
ingredients_raw: Pani Puri Ingredients: Semolina (47%), Palmolein, Whole Wheat Flour (12%), Refined Wheat Flour and Salt. Sweet Spiced Mango Sauce Ingredients: Sugar (48%), Mango Powder, Salt, Black Salt, Black Pepper, Red Chilli Powder, Dry Ginger Powder, Cardamom Powder, Turmeg and Mace. Pani Puri Paste Ingredients: Mint Paste (25%), Dried Mango Slices, Coriander Paste, Salt, Cumin Powder, Green Chilli, Asafotida and Preservative (Sodium Benzoate (E211)). Boondi Ingredients: Chickpeas Flour (65%), Refined Peanut Oil, Salt and Turmeric Powder. CONTAINS WHEAT AND PEANUT COMPONENTS.
